_comment: One place for what testers read on each build: TestFlight's What to Test (tool/testflight.py) and Play's release notes (tool/play_upload.py). Change it with the version in pubspec.yaml; a build whose version is not this one says so in its notes instead of repeating an old release's.
what_to_test: Members' cards held near a reader: 1. On a customer's sale, choose Scan or tap their card. 2. Hold a club members' card (Loughor RFC or Pontardawe RFC app, Android phone or Wear OS watch) near the back of the phone: the member goes on the sale. 3. With a Wallet NFC reader (Google Wallet Smart Tap or Apple Wallet NFC) plugged in by USB or paired by Bluetooth, hold the member's Wallet card near the reader while the sheet is open: the member goes on the sale, as when the QR is scanned. 4. Android TV: the same as 1.2.71, Kitchen or Customer display with the remote; the TV app is also on go.vesopa.com/install.
release_notes: Vesopa Go on your TV: the kitchen board lays tickets out side by side on Android TV and Google TV, and everything works with the remote. Tap a member's phone or watch to find them: Go reads the members' card by NFC.
